video.title: AI欧腐《我的兄弟，我的主人/My Brother，My Master》
video.desc:
确实不错 但是未完结啊 本来不想弄的 毕竟咱也不知道什么时候更
To save his gravely ill mother, Steven returns to the family estate and competes with half-brother Klaus for the trust inheritance. By day they are rivals; by night Steven seeks solace as “Bunny” at a secret club with the mysterious “Wolf”—who is actually Klaus. Klaus discovers White Rabbit’s identity first and becomes entangled in hatred, possessiveness, and attraction. As Rebecca cancels the engagement and Elisa escalates her plot to seize the estate, Steven is kidnapped and thrown into the sea. Klaus risks his life to save him, and they confess their identities and feelings. Elisa is arrested, Steven’s mother is rescued, and the brothers set aside their family feud to choose each other.

为了救重病的母亲，Steven 回到家族庄园，与同父异母的兄弟 Klaus 争夺信托遗产。白天，两人是针锋相对的对手；夜里，Steven 化名"兔子"，在一家秘密俱乐部里向神秘的"狼"寻求慰藉——而"狼"，正是 Klaus。
Klaus 率先识破了"白兔"的身份，从此陷入恨意、占有欲与吸引交织的漩涡。随着 Rebecca 解除婚约、Elisa 为夺取庄园步步加码，Steven 遭人绑架，被扔进了大海。Klaus 冒死将他救回，两人终于坦白了彼此的身份与心意。
Elisa 被捕，Steven 的母亲获救，兄弟俩放下家族宿怨，选择了彼此。
